headline: Senate stakes out the home stretch on college sports rights as athletics reform nears a pivotal vote!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate cleared major hurdles on the Protect College Sports Act with a 74-25 cloture vote, paving the way for final passage Monday. Members also passed mental health screening reforms for pilots and seafood enforcement legislation.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - establish uniform rules for student-athlete name, image, and likeness rights and fair competition in college athletics
onTheFloor.status: Cloture passed 74-25; debate time 4-5:30 PM Monday followed by final vote expected at 5:30 PM

onTheFloor.title: John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act - revise FAA regulations for pilots disclosing mental health diagnoses
Aviation Medication Transparency Act - require FAA to publish approved medication list for airmen and controllers
Lower Elwha Klallam Tribe Project Lands Restoration Act - transfer federal land in Washington to tribal trust

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a brief pro forma session lasting just three minutes, adjourning after introducing 85 bills and 15 resolutions related to veterans affairs, education, and student protections.

onTheFloor.title: Veterans Health Administration sterile processing technician certification requirement
Prohibit educational institutions from withholding transcripts from students using Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits
Protect students from personal surveys and evaluations without parental written consent
